project_type: React Native Expo Mobile POS App

brand_identity.vibe: Clean, Professional, Tablet-Optimized, Thai POS style

structure.top_toolbar: Height 72px, surface background, bottom border. Contains Search, Order Hub, Customer, Settings.
structure.left_rail: Width 120px, surface background, right border. Vertical list of categories.
structure.center_grid: Flex 1, background color. 3 or 4 columns depending on screen size. Padding 16px.
structure.right_cart: Width 320px, surface background, left border. Subtotal, item list, total, large Pay button at bottom.

components.product_card: White background, rounded-2xl, soft shadow. Top half is image (rounded-t-2xl), bottom half has name (body font, semibold) and price (primary color, bold). Touch target must be entire card.
components.category_pill: Rounded-xl padding-md. If active: primary_muted bg, primary text, 2px primary border. If inactive: surface bg, text_body color.
components.cart_item: Row layout. Item name, quantity controls (+/- buttons with 44px touch targets), price.
components.numeric_keypad: Large buttons, min 64x64px, rounded-full or rounded-xl, surface bg, large centered text.
components.payment_modal: Width 80%, Height 80%, centered. Left panel: Payment methods (Easy Pay, Credit, PromptPay, QR Kbank, EDC, Custom). Center: Numpad. Right: Quick amounts (1000, 500, etc).
components.discount_modal: Toggle between Amount/Percent. Quick chips (5%, 10%, 15%, 20%). Numpad for custom. 'Done' button.
components.order_hub: Tabs across top (All, Table, Delivery, KIOSK, Other). Kanban columns (New Order, Preparing, Completed, Cancel). Cards show ID, count, price, delivery status (Grab).
components.login_pin: Centered flex layout. 4 empty dots for PIN state. Large numeric keypad below.
components.customer_search: Modal with list of customers. Show colored avatar circles, name, phone, last visit.

interactions_and_motion.button_press: Use react-native-reanimated for scale down to 0.95 on press-in, spring back on release.
interactions_and_motion.modal_entrance: Slide up from bottom with spring animation.
interactions_and_motion.cart_item_add: Flash background color briefly or slight scale bounce on the cart item.

accessibility_and_testing.touch_targets: Minimum 44x44 points for all interactive elements.
accessibility_and_testing.test_ids: Apply testID (for native) to all interactive elements.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard React Native components (View, Text, TouchableOpacity, FlatList) styled via StyleSheet or inline styles.
Ensure the layout is explicitly forced or optimized for landscape tablet orientation (flexDirection: 'row' for main layout).
Implement the 4-digit PIN login screen as the initial route.
Main screen should have a 3-column flex layout: Left Rail (categories), Center (products), Right Sidebar (cart).
Mock all products with the provided media URLs and appropriate THB pricing.
Implement 'Order Hub' as a full-screen modal or separate route with a Kanban board layout.
Use @expo/vector-icons for all UI icons (Search, Cart, User, Menu).
All modals (Payment, Discount, Customer Search) should be centered and feel like high-quality native modals with overlay backdrops.
Mocked Payment integration: Clicking 'Payment' opens a modal, selecting a method and completing the payment should show a success screen with 'Change Due'.
Ensure typography strictly uses standard Expo system fonts or loads the specified fonts if configured.
Make sure all text elements use <Text> from react-native, not web HTML tags.
